purpose: Availability and JSON handoff only; no extracted measurements or scores

subdimensions.name: Geology
subdimensions.note: Imagery and CF provide context, not mapped geologic units. The USGS geologic map needs a separate GIS adapter.

subdimensions.name: Mineralogy
subdimensions.note: CF is a silicate composition indicator, not a complete mineral inventory.

subdimensions.name: Surface materials
subdimensions.note: Rock fraction and imagery; particle size, regolith depth and bearing strength are not retrieved.

subdimensions.name: Elevation
subdimensions.note: LOLA shape/elevation grid; confirm reference radius and scaling.

subdimensions.name: Slope
subdimensions.note: Archived slope product; retain its baseline and resolution.

subdimensions.name: Roughness
subdimensions.note: Elevation input is available for later RMS roughness calculation; no roughness value is calculated here.

subdimensions.name: Craters
subdimensions.note: Inputs for crater interpretation. No crater detections, counts or complete crater catalog are retrieved.

subdimensions.name: Temperature
subdimensions.note: Bolometric thermal products; local time and season must be selected.

subdimensions.name: Illumination
subdimensions.note: Average Sun visibility candidates; valid pixel coverage and averaging interval remain unverified.

subdimensions.name: Environmental extremes
subdimensions.note: Thermal and lighting inputs only; not a full radiation, vacuum or extreme-environment model.

subdimensions.name: Water
subdimensions.note: Neutron counts provide indirect hydrogen context, not direct water abundance.

subdimensions.name: Ice
subdimensions.note: Hydrogen, radar and shadow evidence cannot by themselves confirm ice at this place.

subdimensions.name: Permafrost
subdimensions.note: Terrestrial permafrost is not a directly transferable lunar layer. Potential subsurface ice is addressed under ice.

subdimensions.name: Resources
subdimensions.note: Exploration context only; no reserve estimate, extractability, grade or resource certification.

subdimensions.name: Dust
subdimensions.note: LADEE LDEX archive exists, but this tester has no adapter for its orbital dust observations; not a local surface dust-hazard map.

subdimensions.name: Wind
subdimensions.note: No terrestrial-style atmospheric wind layer on the Moon; solar wind is a separate physical process.

subdimensions.name: Erosion
subdimensions.note: Imagery is context; impact gardening and erosion rates require temporal observations and a dedicated model.

subdimensions.name: Aeolian processes
subdimensions.note: Atmospheric wind-driven sediment transport is not a lunar process.

subdimensions.name: Biology
subdimensions.note: No lunar biological measurement layer is retrieved. Null means unavailable, not a measured zero.

subdimensions.name: Extremophiles
subdimensions.note: An Earth analog criterion; requires terrestrial biological field data outside this project.

subdimensions.name: Habitability
subdimensions.note: Environmental inputs only. Biological habitability or engineered human habitat suitability requires an explicitly defined model.

subdimensions.name: Biosignatures
subdimensions.note: No biosignature observations retrieved; mineral indicators are not evidence of biology.

subdimensions.name: Caves
subdimensions.note: Context for targeted pit/cave investigations; archive coverage does not establish a cave here.

subdimensions.name: Lava tubes
subdimensions.note: Potential evidence needs site-specific interpretation; no confirmed tube geometry is retrieved.

subdimensions.name: Subsurface
subdimensions.note: Radar scattering context, not a general underground depth map or geotechnical survey.

subdimensions.name: Landing
subdimensions.note: Hazard inputs only; lander footprint, tolerances and resolution requirements must be specified.

subdimensions.name: Mobility
subdimensions.note: Terrain inputs only; vehicle traction and traversability are not measured.

subdimensions.name: Navigation
subdimensions.note: Map and lighting inputs; no navigation accuracy or communication model is retrieved.

subdimensions.name: Robotics
subdimensions.note: Environmental inputs; mission and robot capabilities are required for an assessment.

subdimensions.name: Construction
subdimensions.note: Terrain screening inputs only; no soil bearing strength, excavation resistance or foundation test data.

subdimensions.name: Human factors
subdimensions.note: Requires operational studies and participant evidence; orbital maps cannot provide workload, isolation or team-performance measurements.
